recipes.name: Neutral Fix
recipes.description: A clean starting point: a touch of exposure and contrast, nothing else.

recipes.name: Bright Lift
recipes.description: Opens the frame up with a gentle lift and slightly softer contrast.

recipes.name: Deep Tone
recipes.description: Darker, denser and more contrasty, with the midtones pulled down.

recipes.name: Punch
recipes.description: Crisp, saturated and sharp, for a photo that needs to shout.

recipes.name: Soft Touch
recipes.description: Low contrast and a light diffusion: gentle without going hazy.

recipes.name: Warm Base
recipes.description: A neutral frame with a warm white balance and a little extra colour.

recipes.name: Cool Base
recipes.description: A neutral frame cooled down, with a little more bite in the contrast.

recipes.name: Clean
recipes.description: Neutral, tidy and slightly sharpened: the everyday correction.

recipes.name: Matte Base
recipes.description: Lifted blacks and quiet saturation for a matte print finish.

recipes.name: Faithful
recipes.description: A gentle S-curve that leaves the colour and the white balance alone.

recipes.name: Classic Mono
recipes.description: A neutral black and white with a small midtone lift.

recipes.name: Silver Print
recipes.description: A weighted channel mix and a cool shadow tone, like a fibre silver print.

recipes.name: High Key
recipes.description: Pale, open and airy, with the highlights pushed and the blacks lifted.

recipes.name: Low Key
recipes.description: Dark and heavy, with a deep vignette closing the frame in.

recipes.name: Hard Contrast
recipes.description: Near-black shadows, bright highlights and crisp micro-contrast.

recipes.name: Film Mono
recipes.description: A softer, grainier monochrome with a lifted black.

recipes.name: Selenium
recipes.description: A violet-slate shadow tone over a quiet monochrome.

recipes.name: Platinum
recipes.description: Cool, low contrast and slightly lifted: a platinum print on matte paper.

recipes.name: Infrared
recipes.description: Foliage goes white: a heavy red channel mix with glow and grain.

recipes.name: Ink
recipes.description: Hard contrast, strong structure and grain: ink on rough paper.

recipes.name: Warm Film
recipes.description: A warm, slightly green film stock with soft highlights and grain.

recipes.name: Faded Film
recipes.description: Low contrast, lifted blacks and a cyan-brown crossover with fine grain.

recipes.name: Instant
recipes.description: Instant-camera colour: cyan shadows, cream highlights and a soft lens.

recipes.name: Slide Film
recipes.description: Dense, saturated transparency film with a blue shadow cast.

recipes.name: Seventies
recipes.description: Heavy amber cast, low contrast and coarse grain: a 1974 album cover.

recipes.name: Cross Process
recipes.description: Independent red, green and blue curves: yellow-cyan cast, blown highlights, crushed shadows.

recipes.name: Lomo
recipes.description: Hard vignette, hot colour and a glowy centre: the toy camera look.

recipes.name: Daguerreotype
recipes.description: Brown-silver monochrome with a soft lens and a heavy plate vignette.

recipes.name: Sun Bleached
recipes.description: Faded by a summer on a windowsill: pale, warm and desaturated.

recipes.name: Newsprint
recipes.description: Coarse monochrome dots on cheap paper: faded, soft and grainy.

recipes.name: Vivid
recipes.description: Saturated, vibrant and a little more contrasty, without hue shifts.

recipes.name: Filmic
recipes.description: A subtle camera matrix and a neutral split tone: filmic, not stylised.

recipes.name: Matte Pastel
recipes.description: Pale, airy and low in contrast, with warm highlights and a little bloom.

recipes.name: Teal & Orange
recipes.description: Cinematic teal shadows against warm skin and amber highlights.

recipes.name: Earth Tones
recipes.description: Hues pushed toward clay and moss, with the saturation held back.

recipes.name: Mint
recipes.description: A cool green cast in the shadows and pale highlights over clean colour.

recipes.name: Amber
recipes.description: Warm amber midtones with a rich, low-contrast shadow.

recipes.name: Sapphire
recipes.description: Deep blue shadows against cool, clean highlights.

recipes.name: Neutralize
recipes.description: Removes a colour cast and leaves the frame straight and quiet.

recipes.name: Hue Pop
recipes.description: Maximum colour energy: vibrance and saturation up, highlights glowing.

recipes.name: Soft Blur
recipes.description: A real, even blur at six pixels, with the blacks lifted a touch.

recipes.name: Dream Blur
recipes.description: Soft focus and a broad warm bloom: a lens wide open in the evening.

recipes.name: Motion Blur
recipes.description: A short horizontal smear: a moving subject at a slow shutter.

recipes.name: Zoom Blur
recipes.description: A small rotational smear that reads as a zoom pull toward the centre.

recipes.name: Radial Spin
recipes.description: A stronger arc smear with the corners pulled down: a slow pan shot.

recipes.name: Tilt Shift
recipes.description: A horizontal band of focus with the rest of the frame thrown out.

recipes.name: Bokeh
recipes.description: A radial blur away from the centre, with the highlights blooming.

recipes.name: Fog
recipes.description: Soft, low contrast and cool: a morning where the detail disappears.

recipes.name: Diffusion
recipes.description: A pro-mist filter: the highlights bleed, the blacks stay, nothing goes soft.

recipes.name: Frosted Glass
recipes.description: A two-pixel blur with heavy grain: looking through rippled glass.

recipes.name: Crisp
recipes.description: A small-radius unsharp mask: edges get a clean bite.

recipes.name: Clarity
recipes.description: Midtone local contrast: presence without halos.

recipes.name: Micro Detail
recipes.description: Fine texture and grain-level structure, pushed hard at a tiny radius.

recipes.name: Structure
recipes.description: Large-radius local contrast with the colour pulled back.

recipes.name: Emboss
recipes.description: A relief map of the frame: grey, raised and quite strange.

recipes.name: Edge Line
recipes.description: Edges only, dark and bright, on a near-black field.

recipes.name: Pencil
recipes.description: Graphite line work: soft edges inverted onto pale paper, with a light tooth.

recipes.name: Charcoal
recipes.description: A smudged monochrome with heavy black: charcoal on rough stock.

recipes.name: Etch
recipes.description: Fine edges, inverted and posterised, like a plate ready for the press.

recipes.name: Dry Brush
recipes.description: Oil paint over an emboss: texture you can almost feel.

recipes.name: Oil Paint
recipes.description: Thick, rounded brush strokes with the colour lifted.

recipes.name: Chalk Pastel
recipes.description: Soft pigment on textured paper: chalky, desaturated and lifted.

recipes.name: Wash
recipes.description: A pale, soft wash over textured paper, with the whites left glowing.

recipes.name: Painterly
recipes.description: Flat, poster-like brush regions with the colour pushed up.

recipes.name: Pop Art
recipes.description: Four flat inks printed with a hard register.

recipes.name: Comic
recipes.description: Inked edges over flat, saturated colour.

recipes.name: Ink Wash
recipes.description: Black ink diluted over wet paper, with the highlights bleeding.

recipes.name: Mosaic
recipes.description: Square tesserae with a limited palette.

recipes.name: Impasto
recipes.description: Raised paint: strokes plus relief, with the colour lifted.

recipes.name: Stencil
recipes.description: Three tone separations cut out of a single sheet.

recipes.name: Swirl
recipes.description: A 45 degree twist around the centre, with the corners held down.

recipes.name: Vortex
recipes.description: A full whirl: a third of a turn, with the contrast pushed.

recipes.name: Implode
recipes.description: The frame is pulled into its centre.

recipes.name: Explode
recipes.description: The frame is pushed outward from the centre.

recipes.name: Wave
recipes.description: A long, gentle sine wave across the frame.

recipes.name: Ripple
recipes.description: A short, tight ripple, like heat over a road.

recipes.name: Mirror
recipes.description: The left half flipped onto the right: one perfect axis of symmetry.

recipes.name: Kaleidoscope
recipes.description: Six rotated copies overlaid: a mandala from one frame.

recipes.name: Pinch
recipes.description: A small implosion with the corners pulled down to hold the eye in.

recipes.name: Stretch
recipes.description: A 12 percent horizontal stretch, cropped back to the frame.

recipes.name: Golden Hour
recipes.description: Warm late sun on the highlights without turning skin orange.

recipes.name: Light Leak
recipes.description: A warm leak down the right edge, as if the back of the camera opened.

recipes.name: Haze
recipes.description: Flat, bright and cool: distance disappearing into the air.

recipes.name: Venice
recipes.description: Late-afternoon stone, slate-blue shadows and a soft halation on the highlights.

recipes.name: Backlight
recipes.description: The light comes from behind the subject and eats the highlights.

recipes.name: Window Light
recipes.description: A soft key from the left, falling off across the frame.

recipes.name: Dusk
recipes.description: Cool blue evening light with a dusty pink highlight.

recipes.name: Dawn
recipes.description: Pale peach sun on a lavender shadow, still holding the morning air.

recipes.name: Spotlight
recipes.description: A hard pool of light in the middle of a dark stage.

recipes.name: Nordic
recipes.description: Cool, clean and high-key: blue shadows and near-neutral highlights.

recipes.name: Fine Grain
recipes.description: A light, even monochrome grain: modern stock, slightly pushed.

recipes.name: Medium Grain
recipes.description: More visible grain over a slightly desaturated, contrastier frame.

recipes.name: Coarse Grain
recipes.description: Big, chunky grain with hard contrast and the corners pulled down.

recipes.name: Push Process
recipes.description: Two stops pushed: bright, contrasty, saturated and grainy.

recipes.name: ISO 1600
recipes.description: High-speed film: grainy, slightly flat and vignetted.

recipes.name: Dust & Scratches
recipes.description: Grain plus a scatter of dust across a clean frame.

recipes.name: Paper Grain
recipes.description: The tooth of a fine paper under a slightly warm frame.

recipes.name: TV Static
recipes.description: Heavy monochrome noise over a six level quantise: no signal.

recipes.name: Snow
recipes.description: Colour noise on an eight level screen: an untuned channel.

recipes.name: Film Base
recipes.description: Warm film base under even grain, with the blacks lifted.

recipes.name: Halftone
recipes.description: A classic angled dot screen over a neutral monochrome.

recipes.name: Risograph
recipes.description: Two ink riso: blue-black shadows and cream paper, dotted.

recipes.name: Rotary Press
recipes.description: A rotary plate: hard dots, three ink densities, cheap paper.

recipes.name: Cyanotype
recipes.description: Prussian blue and paper white, with the grain of the coating.

recipes.name: Screen Print
recipes.description: Four flat colours pulled through a mesh.

recipes.name: Lithograph
recipes.description: Hard monochrome with grain and a heavy stone vignette.

recipes.name: Engraving
recipes.description: A relief plate inked in black: fine lines, hard contrast.

recipes.name: Rubber Stamp
recipes.description: Two levels, two inks, and a hard edge.

recipes.name: Duotone
recipes.description: A two colour map from deep navy to pale sand.

recipes.name: Sepia Drama
recipes.description: A three-stop sepia print on textured paper, with a heavy vignette and grain.

recipes.name: Bloom
recipes.description: Highlights bloom gently, with the contrast pulled back to hold it.

recipes.name: Halo
recipes.description: A wide glow plus a soft focus: light that spreads past its edges.

recipes.name: Neon Night
recipes.description: Deep shadows, blue midtones and magenta highlights with strong bloom.

recipes.name: Two Tone
recipes.description: A violet to turquoise duotone with the highlights lifted.

recipes.name: Pop
recipes.description: Vivid, sharp and glowy: maximum colour with a crisp edge.

recipes.name: Daydream
recipes.description: Soft, warm and hazy, with a lavender shadow and a pink glow.

recipes.name: Chrome
recipes.description: Cool, hard and metallic, with the highlights rolling to blue.

recipes.name: Sunset
recipes.description: A three stop sunset map from violet through red to gold.

recipes.name: Aurora
recipes.description: Green shadows and violet highlights, glowing and saturated.

recipes.name: Ember
recipes.description: A dark frame with an orange glow in the highlights: coals, not fire.
